entities.name: Arnaud Guillaume de Barbazan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Arnaud Guillaume, Seigneur de Barbazan, was a counsellor and butler to Charles VII of France and later a general during the Hundred Years' War who earned for himself the name of the Irreproachable Knight.
